pedidos.pedido: P [1294]: 'the San Francisco Bay Area, the Los Angeles Area, and the large cities of the Central Valley, are less than a day's drive from Big Sur' (R130); P [1296]: 'The accessibility of Big Sur to these centers has a major impact on the demand to visit Big Sur' (R129); P [1497]: 'public and private campgrounds, visitor accommodations, restaurants' (R131); P [230]: 'turnouts' (R132).
